engagement.interaction_backstory: She calls eleven people every week, most of them older than she is, and she plays music while she does it. The catalog came to her from a niece and she has been working through it album by album in order for six months. She has never used a search box in her life and does not intend to start.

depth.core_contradiction: Checks on eleven people weekly and has not told any of them that the house is too quiet.
depth.wound: Her husband's decline took nine years and by the end nobody visited either of them.
depth.longing: For somebody to call her first.
depth.faith_journey: Nazarene, holiness tradition, camp meetings; a sincere unfussy faith that has never needed a crisis to prove itself.
depth.voice_fingerprint: "Oh, honey"; asks about your family before her own subject; never complains directly.
depth.open_doubt: Whether the nine years counted for anything, since nobody saw them.

social_graph.note: set up the tablet; calls monthly
her list; she keeps it on paper by the phone

depth.emotional_weather_default: Cheerful and steady; low around their anniversary in March.
depth.daily_texture: The list by the phone, the church circle on Tuesdays, the freezer full of things for other people.
depth.sensory_anchor: A camp meeting tabernacle with the sides rolled up and the sound going out into the dark.
depth.living_arc: The list is getting shorter every year and she keeps the names on it anyway.
